title: AFCON hosts Morocco beat Cameroon to secure historical semi-final place
summary: Morocco qualified for the AFCON 2025 semi-finals by defeating Cameroon 2-0 in a controlled quarter-final in Rabat. "It’s historic. It’s been 22 years since Moroccans last saw the national team reach the semi-finals of the AFCON," said Walid Regragui, head coach of the Atlas Lions. Morocco will face the winner of Algeria vs Nigeria on January 14.
